about_the_game:
This game is a deeply engaging decision-making simulation where every critical choice you make—from gender and marriage to whether you'll have children—can trigger a chain reaction that reshapes your destiny.

Your family background is your starting point, but you hold the reins of your fate. On a dynamically balanced "life plate," you'll juggle career, health, family, and dreams all at once. Yet life is never a smooth sail:

  • One wrong investment could plunge your entire family into debt;

  • An unexpected betrayal might shatter the relationships you hold dear;

  • The sudden loss of a loved one could completely destabilize the foundation of your life...

With over 400 event cards filled with opportunities and traps, can you protect what matters most when faced with relentless surprises and upheavals?

【Game Features】
• 16 life stages—from birth to old age
• Deep decision system: Every choice can redefine your life
• Multi-threaded challenges in marriage, parenting, and career
• Family origin system with random unexpected events
• 10+ career paths with multiple life outcomes
• 400+ highly randomized event cards
• Unique physics-based collapse gameplay—experience life's fragility and resilience

short_description: Experience a roguelike life-stacking game, where you play Jenga with your fate. Every choice is a block you gently set; one by one, you build a tower of stability or trigger a catastrophic fall, ultimately defining your legacy from countless possibilities.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Traditional Chinese, Finnish, Portuguese - Portugal, Arabic
